data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Mawara is derived from the Arabic word 'Mawar', which means 'to turn around'. This name symbolizes the journey of life and the constant movement towards spiritual growth. It is mentioned in the Quran, where it is used to describe the angels circling around Allah. The name Mawara carries the meaning “A Traveler” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mawara usually hope their child will grow to embody a traveler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
